SELECT s.store_id < 900 AS is_physical, s.store_id = 999 AS is_999, p.category = 'ZZ Test' AS is_test, f.vat_rate, p.vat_class,
  count(*) AS line_count, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS distinct_lines, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS distinct_receipt_lines,
  sum(f.net_amount) AS net, sum(f.gross_amount) AS gross, sum(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS vat,
  sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate)) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inconsistent_lines,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.channel_code <> 'ST' OR f.channel_code IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_st
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

SELECT f.sale_date >= DATE '2024-09-01' AS on_or_after_1sep, f.vat_rate, count(*) AS n, min(f.sale_date) AS first_day, max(f.sale_date) AS last_day,
  sum(f.net_amount) AS net, sum(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS vat, sum(CASE WHEN f.net_amount < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative_lines,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS staff_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

WITH mine AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date, s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) AS net
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY ALL
), ctl AS (
  SELECT business_date AS sale_date, store_id, net_sales_before_returns AS ctl_net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
  WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND store_id < 900
)
SELECT count(*) AS store_days, sum(coalesce(mine.net,0)) AS mine_total, sum(coalesce(ctl.ctl_net,0)) AS ctl_total,
  sum(CASE WHEN abs(coalesce(mine.net,0)-coalesce(ctl.ctl_net,0)) > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mismatched_store_days
FROM mine FULL OUTER JOIN ctl USING (sale_date, store_id)

WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.vat_rate, count(*) AS sales_lines, sum(f.net_amount) AS net_sales_excl_vat, sum(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS vat_charged
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY f.vat_rate
), refunded AS (
  SELECT r.vat_rate, sum(r.refund_gross - r.refund_net) AS vat_refunded
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY r.vat_rate
)
SELECT sold.vat_rate, sold.vat_charged, refunded.vat_refunded, sold.net_sales_excl_vat FROM sold LEFT JOIN refunded USING (vat_rate) ORDER BY 1
